en.title: Keen Bean – Mac meeting notes that draft the spec while you talk
en.hook: A Mac meeting notes app that auto‑drafts specifications as you speak, streamlining collaboration and documentation.
key_takeaways: Real‑time transcription and template‑based drafting turn conversations into structured specs instantly
Seamless version control and sharing boost team productivity
Lightweight UI makes it accessible for both technical and non‑technical users

zh.title: Keen Bean——一款能边聊天边自动生成文档的Mac会议笔记工具

key_takeaways: 实时转录和模板化起草将对话直接转化为结构化文档
无缝版本控制和分享提升团队协作效率
简洁的界面让技术和非技术用户都能轻松上手
